compatibility.boundary: This is a worker-directed Firstmate skill. Use it only within the accepted task contract. Firstmate owns dispatch, delivery, no-mistakes, isolated worktrees, decision holds, and captain authority. Any suggested parallel worker or reviewer is advisory until Firstmate routes it through the approved dispatch path; never use vendor-specific hidden delegation, cloud agents, or an unapproved model runner.

skill_notes.architect: Architectural alternatives may be requested through Firstmate's approved dispatch path, with one isolated worktree per writer. If no such dispatch is available, compare bounded advisory sketches in the current worker.
skill_notes.how: For complex explanations, optional explorers and synthesis are advisory worker roles. Route them through Firstmate's normal dispatch path when used, and keep the current worker able to answer without hidden delegation.
skill_notes.why: Query only evidence tools actually available in this Firstmate environment. Use git and gh-axi for GitHub history, report unavailable categories as gaps, and never imply that an absent MCP or source was searched.
skill_notes.arena: Candidate fan-out is optional and worker-directed. If used, request isolated candidates through Firstmate's approved dispatch path and never create a second swarm, PR, or CI control plane.
skill_notes.interrogate: Adversarial findings are a review artifact only. Do not auto-apply them, merge a PR, or bypass no-mistakes. Route any needed change through the current worker and Firstmate's delivery authority.
skill_notes.create-verification-skill: Use the project's actual browser, CLI, or HTTP conventions. Firstmate uses chrome-devtools-axi for browser work, gh-axi for GitHub, and lavish-axi for structured reports. There is no supported iOS or simulator recipe in this skill; record that bounded limitation instead of inventing tooling.
skill_notes.figure-it-out: Replace the upstream entry point with the relevant Firstmate principles and the task's own brief. Firstmate's accepted intent, escalation, decision-hold, and delivery contracts remain controlling.
skill_notes.maintain-verification-skill: Ship proven verification-skill corrections only through Firstmate's configured delivery path. Never merge or create an independent review control plane.
